[i]RP tingy 2[/i]
[u][b]Investigation into potential weapon leaks.[/b][/u]

Having recived permission to conduct investigations into the weapon stockpiles left over from the terrorist organization that ones ruled Sal-baliz Nordiheim would send a large team to be able to do this quickly.
This team was ordered to conduct themself propperly and be polite and propper towards the Balizid National Guard and the THEP security forces that would be supervising them to avoid any incidents that would hinder their ability to do the investigations that was needed.

Meanwile the Garkain warhead would be taken appart to examine every singel component of it to hopefully identify its exact production number as it could potentialy give clues to find out how it got out of their hands to begin with.
Some theorized that it might be a warhead from the early stages of the Garkain program back in the late 70s wich would make the most sense.
As such a compleat investigation into the full Garkain warhead stockpile and storage would also be conducted, even for the prototypes regardless if they had been successfull or not, together with finding and monitoring all scientists and military personell that had ever been allowed to interact with the program incase any one of them had been compromised in some way.

The council and military command of Nordiheim could for now only wait for the results and hope that the potential weapons leaks were not as bad as their worst possible predictions.

[b][u]Sending trade deligations:[/u][/b]

While the numerous investigations were underway or being started it did not mean that the council could forget about their work when it came to diplomacy and international trade.
Two diplomatic teams would be sendt out;
One to The Shamatine Kingdom of [nation]Sal-Baliz[/nation] to start up propper trade with them for the first time.
And another one to the Federal Democratic Republic of [nation]United Hydronia[/nation] to hopefully expand and improve the allready existing resource deal into someting larger and greater.

There was hope for a potential weapons or vehicle deal to be made with the Hydronians to keep the Nordiheimian ecconomy to going hot for potentialy several years if any more deals like the ones made with Italian dutch could be made, though it was not guarantied.
As such some of the best negotiators were sendt on the diplomatic mission to United Hydronia.

[i]((These negotiations will proberly be done on discord and then the result anounced here on the RMB :P ))[/i]
